# Pi Mobile — source map for code agents

Read AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/protocol.md and current owners/code/tests before changing code. Read loop-develop/README.md and its active goal only for an explicitly requested long-term migration; a goal file alone does not authorize restarting the rewrite. This repository is a mobile window onto the SAME running Pi in Orca; tests must not reload/interrupt it or send paid prompts. Billy explicitly requested commit, push and GitHub release0.6.008 on8 October2026; versionCode15, previous certificate/dependencies unchanged. Current release evidence/limits: docs/release-0.6.008.md. Earlier0.6.006 publication/delivery is completed history; the current request does not include a new Telegram delivery. Billy requested a coherent whole-product visual redesign on 7 October based on assistant-ui/Mobbin, not another component list; current local changes/evidence are in docs/ui-redesign-20261007.md. The redesign retained signature/dependencies; release metadata is now0.6.008/versionCode15. It uses borderless neutral surfaces, bare collapsible tools, full-canvas reading behind floating header/composer gradients, and a full-width writing row over four controls. Only confirmed live active agents/workflows appear in the dock; workflow detail is actual phases → agents with tools/tokens/time. Queue above input is the app's busy Follow Up receipt projection, not a global scheduler: ACK does not consume, new canonical echoes consume FIFO, restored accepted queue is Last known, UNCERTAIN is Unknown and reconnect never replays. Catalog uses plain compact rows, a muted workspace label distinct from16sp regular chat titles, and compact unified Usage with an official black/white OpenAI SVG/vector (docs/ui-assets/openai). Typography rationale/source limitations: docs/ui-typography-20261007.md. Header shows the actual host with connection icon/spinner LEFT and8dp gap, separate equal48dp refresh/settings actions at4dp gap. Never show an unsubmitted Settings draft as the connected host or expose URL credentials/query/path. Read belongs only to the latest user submission and disappears for a newer unacknowledged message; the older-history banner is removed, not pagination. Tool header is only rolling latest actual name/count; individual failures remain specific. Quick effort track33dp, no pending line, rejection above controls; ACK guards and manual dismissal remain. Release0.6.008 and committing/pushing main are explicitly authorized; do not infer authorization for future releases, Telegram delivery or host deployment. Do not deploy or alter the running Pi/Orca/gateway.

UI: tap connected host → Computers, select or Add/Edit; Settings saves name/URL/own token and confirms device-local Forget. One mobile socket, at most32 profiles. core/ConnectionProfile contains safe metadata only; store/ConnectionProfiles owns canonical URL identity, lazy legacy envelope/address preservation and atomic profile/active-mirror writes through ports. SettingsStore preserves AES-GCM/AndroidKeyStore alias; never reset the shared key to forget one computer. Blank tokens only reuse that exact known endpoint. Changing hosts retires catalog/HTTP generations/launch/mutation expectations, closes history/usage/media; PiClient clears subscription/snapshot/config/catalog and does not replay uncertain commands. Activity/navigation/restored image scope is an opaque endpoint/token digest, not credentials; HTTP/media use frozen credentials. PendingMessages host/session format is unchanged; cache remains endpoint/token/session scoped. Private release keystore preserves the legacy certificate/key, not a new production identity. Product/version state: README.md (v0.6.009/code16, saved computers and genuine release variant; current checks and physical-device limits in docs/release-0.6.009.md). Truthful architecture map: docs/architecture.md. Exact current class ownership: architecture/owners.json; feature passports: architecture/capsules/README.md. Visual references: docs/ui-baseline/README.md and immutable PNGs/manifest.json. Wire semantics/security: docs/protocol.md, docs/setup.md; release checks: docs/verification.md.

Android (android/app/src/main/java/ru/billyhargrove/pimobile): PiApp composes the process; MainActivity.kt composes features/catalog/CatalogSession (confirmed scoped commands, lifecycle generations) and CatalogScreen (Compose catalog/direct history and grouped settings), internal ArchiveSession/Projection/Screen and UsageSession/Projection/Screen; ArchiveSheet/UsageCards adapt only Android modal, I/O and timers. Request/poll identities retire stale and duplicate callbacks. Search owns its debounce; pending delete requires one confirmation and is not resent. Immutable quota/date projections are prepared once per accepted response, with unknown-vs-zero usage and unique date-run keys. See docs/architecture-catalog-20261007.md. ChatActivity.kt is a Kotlin lifecycle/platform shell for features/chat/ChatSession (injected transport, canonical state, scoped event/JSON adaptation, injected transport and public request/viewport facades), ChatOutbox (receipts, retained drafts, revision-owned publication and explicit retry/restore) and Compose ChatScreen (reader/canvas with internal ChatHeader, ChatComposer, ChatWorkDock; shared PiIconButton). OrchestrationActivity.kt is a lifecycle/navigation/IO shell for internal features/orchestration/OrchestrationSession (injected read-only transport, generation/request/single-flight, notices/source/cursor/disclosure/follow-tail), OrchestrationProjection (pure branch/phase/static metrics) and OrchestrationScreen (Compose geometry/duration/navigation callbacks). No credentials/platform/command transport in the feature owner; ui/PiTranscript is consumed without optional command actions. Static tool/token aggregates are computed once per snapshot, not by the duration ticker; actual Android counter is2→2 instead of4→6. Local architecture changes, tests/limits and next slices: docs/architecture-work-20261007.md. Further review/decomposition/stability and chat arrival changes: docs/review-architecture-20261007.md. Scoped PendingCommands, detached-ticket reconciliation, credential-scoped MediaLoader, single-flight Markdown binding and shared AgentMetrics preserve their current owners. Stable row keys and same-epoch overlapping snapshot merge retain reader history; catch-up uses geometry-preserving opacity and smooth measured tail following. These architecture slices are included in release0.6.007; their original reports describe the pre-bump local checks. TranscriptPresentation is the shared presentation policy; old chat Java widgets/adapter/XML are removed. Internal ModelCapabilities projects/deduplicates registry/capabilities once; ModelSettingsSession/Screen own the draft/search/explicit Apply and QuickEffortSession/Screen own preview/commit/pending/confirmed rollback. ModelSettingsSheet and EffortPopup retain modal/anchor/platform hosts. Successful ACK confirms only the submitted field when no newer report of that field exists; partial configuration does not confirm unrelated pending changes. A failure after closing its panel appears in the chat notice. These owners consume only results scoped by ChatSession. EffortSlider.kt is the Compose brain control shared by both panels and accepts immutable projected levels; TierToggle shares the same capability policy. See docs/architecture-configuration-20261007.md. PiTheme owns the neutral palettes/default content color. All production Android source is Kotlin. Markwon/LaTeX and image zoom remain bounded native leaves; model/effort/dictation/document/update containers render Compose in owned platform modal hosts. Legacy screen XML/adapters are removed. Integrated Node/JVM/build and all synthetic UI scenarios have passing coverage, including focused fixes, display/motion checks and actual read-only relay. In-place upgrade/rollback retains encrypted settings/outbox; physical-device acceptance remains open. core/net/store/media retain existing contracts and private data. Read current tests/owners/passports before editing; no permanent dual implementations. Billy's six ChatGPT screenshots and effort-slider video are the original design direction (goal/slice004); 0.6.005 explicitly removes the left drawer and all lower Toast/Snackbar notifications. Effort/model/tier selections and ACK do not auto-dismiss their panels. Keep composer IME options stable through keyboard dismissal; read receipts are quiet captions outside bubbles. The immutable UI baseline remains a behavior/before reference.

Local updater slice: ui/AppUpdates preserves its catalog/lifecycle API; internal UpdateSession owns request/permission/cancellation state through main-thread injected ports and UpdateScreen presents existing modals. net/ReleaseClient is independent public unauthenticated HTTP with bounded metadata/streaming, checked redirects, request-local cancellation and unique partial files. ui/UpdateInstaller alone verifies package/newer version/exact signing certificates and opens Android. Cancel/close retire callbacks; permission Later drops the pending action and only explicit settings return can install once. Version0.6.007/code14 unchanged; no new publication. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-updater-20261007.md.

Local voice slice: public DictationRecorder keeps constructor/cancel/constants; internal RecordingSession owns main-thread state/deadline/finish/cancel through injected ports, RecordingScreen preserves modal geometry, media/PcmRecorder owns AudioRecord/private PCM/resource release and coalesced meter delivery. Pure core/PcmAudio centralizes bounds/RMS and HttpApi preflight alignment checks. Capture cancellation/Back/onStop retire callbacks and delete only their file; accepted file ownership goes to the existing transcription/draft caller. Already-started HTTP transcription is a separate scope. No auto-send, version bump or publication. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-voice-20261007.md.

Local transcription slice: features/chat/TranscriptionSession owns single-flight draft handoff and result identity through platform-free ports; net/SpeechTranscriber owns PCM cleanup, bounded-pool HTTP work and request-local cancellation. HttpApi retains its blocking API/wire and exposes an internal cancellable transcription call. onStop/onStart retain the same request; onDestroy retires the ticket and aborts HTTP. Queued cancellation deletes PCM before work; an active reader keeps its file until finally cleanup. Stale callbacks cannot overwrite draft/notices/busy; ChatSession inserts at the current cursor without sending a prompt. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-transcription-20261008.md.

Ownership guard: owners.json declares file-level publicFeatureApis, compositionRoots and bounded platformInteropDependencies. Shared ui/ does not expose every feature implementation; wildcard/aliased imports and secondary Kotlin exports are checked too. sourceContracts registers profiled state/projection/presentation import and dependency direction checks (including same-package references); unknown/unowned contracts fail closed. These bounded source checks are not full Kotlin/reflection analysis. See loop-develop/slices/006-final-acceptance-audit.md for final evidence and open device/session checks.

Local attachment slice: internal features/chat/AttachmentSession owns picker single-flight/free slots/request retirement through opaque URI/value ports. media/AttachmentImporter owns the background batch and staged-thumbnail transfer; AttachmentRead caps bytes and closes its active stream on cancel; PickedAttachments owns ContentResolver metadata/image/file/thumbnail adaptation. Public net/AttachmentPreparer and media/ImagePreparer signatures remain; exact positive remaining budget replaces the erroneous64KiB floor. Display name is queried once per picked item. onStop retains import; onDestroy retires then cancels, and cancelled/late batches cannot alter the draft or free accepted thumbnails. Keep original partial-success prefix, manual send,3 attachments/10MiB output limit and immutable payloads. No version bump/publication; evidence and limits: docs/architecture-attachments-20261008.md.

Local document slice: internal features/chat/DocumentSession owns read-only single-flight ticket, data-once completion, cancel/close and detached-ledger reconciliation through path/request/result ports. ChatSession delegates its existing document API and routes scoped data/ACK/uncertain events; cancel retires local waiting only, never sends a remote cancel/control. DocumentScreen owns existing Compose geometry/scroll through an injected native Markdown leaf; public MarkdownPreview keeps its four-argument constructor and owns native renderer/modal cleanup. Activity guards finishing/destroyed results, scopes dismissal by window identity, and reuses a visible window only for the same path+source so scroll/one parse survive repeated content. Relative link resolution preserves existing semantics; platform/gateway still validate/constrain paths. Read-only previews do not modify draft/outbox or send prompts. No new version/publication; checks/limits: docs/architecture-documents-20261008.md.

Host: server/gateway.mjs is composition root for HTTP/WS/Unix bridge; server/command-policy.mjs validates bounded commands, server/message-projection.mjs sanitizes transcript rows, server/media-cache.mjs bounds image bytes, server/session-projection.mjs sanitizes public configuration and snapshot frames; server/orchestration.mjs owns bounded read-only workflow/agent storage; extension/mobile.ts interfaces with Pi; contracts/agent-transcript.mjs contains pure transcript projection shared between server and extension; contracts/command-receipts.mjs shares bounded mutation-only deduplication, excluding history/document/MCP reads. Neither runtime imports the other's implementation. Do not alter live gateway or Pi processes for validation.

Gates: npm run quality (Node tests, ownership/import boundaries, screenshot hashes), then android/gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest with JDK17 and API35 SDK. ADB Android UI tests do not dispatch prompts. Run final checks after the rewrite, then focused checks for concrete failures. Release0.6.007 was pushed/published and verified (docs/release-0.6.007.md); the local updater slice is not a new publication. For a subsequently requested release, preserve the certificate, verify in-place upgrade and actual GitHub APK/digest/latest state. Physical-device acceptance is still required for the full goal. Architecture guards must grow with ownership changes, not be bypassed.

Local chat pagination slice: internal features/chat/HistorySession owns epoch/cursor/ticket, data-once acceptance, ACK-gated automatic context pagination, duplicate/cyclic cursor fences, detached-ledger reconciliation and local close through typed ports. ChatSession retains scoped JSON adaptation and public loadOlder/historyLoading; Activity closes waiting onDestroy. Canonical TranscriptStore maintains a user-context count on replace/apply/prepend/remove/clear, avoiding the extra per-update transcript copy/scan; optimistic receipts cannot satisfy this context. Failures/missing data do not automatically retry the same cursor on streaming; reader gesture may retry failed reads. Accepted cursors cannot repeat within one pagination chain. Authoritative snapshots reset the chain, including same-epoch replacements that discarded a prefix. Existing stable-key prepend/reader anchor, follow-tail, arrival animation, read-only and protocol/signature/version remain unchanged. Checks/limits: docs/architecture-history-20261008.md.

Local chat control slice: internal features/chat/ControlSession owns typed MCP/rename commands, strict existing syntax/capability/attachment/read-only guards, one pending control and an independent single-flight stop, data-once MCP acceptance, scoped terminal callbacks, detached-ledger reconciliation and local close. ChatSession keeps the public send/abort API, session/type scoping, JSON adaptation and unchanged draft comparison. MCP success without data keeps the command draft and reports missing status; only a request explicitly issued for MCP can open its status. Internal pure McpProjection prepares an immutable body/timestamp once per accepted reply. Activity retains existing native title/message/Done and time-format leaf; it owns one MCP dialog, guards finishing/destroyed effects, clears its reference before destroy dismissal and scopes dismissal by window identity. Stop ACK confirms acceptance, not IDLE/completion. No reconnect replay, prompt send, remote cancellation or protocol/version/dependency changes. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-controls-20261008.md.

Local configuration request slice: internal features/chat/ConfigurationSession owns typed nullable provider/model/effort/tier ports, one reserved-before-write ticket, existing read-only/idle-model policy, scoped ACK/uncertain, detached-ledger reconciliation and local close. ChatSession retains public configure/configurationPending, canonical JSON reports and transport adaptation; panels retain field-specific draft/confirmed rollback and user dismissal. Configuration reports do not settle requests; ACK does not optimistically change canonical model/effort/tier/status/draft. Null/empty IDs and setup exceptions release pending with feedback; reconnect never replays. Activity closes the request and clears/dismisses both panels onDestroy, guards late configuration effects and panel opening. Package/version/certificate/dependencies unchanged. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-configuration-requests-20261008.md.

Local viewport slice: internal features/chat/ViewportSession owns follow-tail, tail/arrival revisions, cached restoration once, reader-generation/manual-drag fence, catch-up phases, new-activity disclosure and local close through typed position ports. ChatSession retains public Viewport/getters/methods and canonical presentation/scoped event JSON; Compose reads owner snapshot state through unchanged getters. Android/Compose alone measure/animate/scroll, preserve stable keys and progress-prefix fallback, and key restoration/arrival completion effects by chat identity. Manual dragging forbids a delayed saved anchor from overriding current reading; reentrant load is reserved before the port. Arrival comparison keeps existing new-vs-changed semantics in one pass without the filtered temporary list. Close retires transient signals without clearing canonical data/saved positions or sending commands. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-viewport-20261008.md.

Local outbox slice: internal pure features/chat/QueueProjection owns ordered new-canonical-USER consumption and the bounded 1500-key suffix. It walks canonical rows once to collect user candidates, never mutates input receipts, consumes one echo per queued request, and reuses unchanged receipt references. Public ChatOutbox retains receipt/draft ownership and explicit sender/retry/restore APIs; it caches read-only receipt/queue lists and owns a revision reserved before its typed persistence callback. Unchanged streaming/snapshots do not encode receipts again; failed saves remain retryable and an older completion cannot overwrite a newer saved revision. ChatSession still adapts scoped frames/ACK/unknown results and delegates its existing persistence port. PendingMessages/codec keep the host/session text-only format and their existing JSON equality guard. Restored SENDING becomes UNCERTAIN (Unknown); restored accepted queue is Last known; reconnect never replays. No geometry/protocol/version/dependency/publication changes. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-outbox-20261008.md.

Local composer slice: internal platform-free features/chat/ComposerSession<Value, Attachment> owns opaque editor/attachment values, preparation/transcription flags, caret insertion and guarded restore/consumption. ChatSession keeps its public facade and adapts TextFieldValue through three editor operations; full externally supplied selection/composition stays intact. Successful send clears only the exact owner/revision snapshot, preserving reentrant next drafts; outbox keeps submitted text/bytes. Empty batches and invalid removal reuse read-only lists. onStop retains, onDestroy retires draft callbacks before cancelling I/O. No UI geometry/protocol/version/dependency/publication changes. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-composer-20261008.md.

Local transcript slice: internal platform-free features/chat/TranscriptSession owns canonical TranscriptStore snapshots and visible projection. ChatSession retains scoped JSON/presence/epoch/history adaptation and the public items/toggle API. The owner reuses each ChangeSet snapshot through outbox overlay, receipt checkpoint, viewport publication and rendered signals. Shared pure core/TranscriptPresentation.update batches source/status/metadata and caches topology/visible rows/tool membership; equal updates preserve row/items identities. Manual disclosure/one-time settlement, snapshot status precedence, epoch reset and prepend/no arrival are unchanged. Input sources are copied; owned/published lists are read-only. No protocol/geometry/version/dependency/publication changes. Evidence/limits: docs/architecture-transcript-20261008.md.

Local configuration-panel slice: internal platform-free features/chat/ConfigurationPanels owns opening/fallback/editability, routing results only to visible waiting panels, fallback chat feedback and local disposal through typed native-host ports. ChatActivity retains windows, IME/anchor and explicit configure callbacks; public EffortPopup/ModelSettingsSheet constructors remain compatible. Pure ModelCapabilities.find projects only the selected valid model within the 1000-entry registry bound. Quick reports avoid a full catalog/map and unrelated capability arrays; partial reports skip the registry. Explicit equal effort/tier reports still advance their independent ACK fences; reports never consume tickets or alter a model draft snapshot, and ACK never dismisses a panel. ConfigurationPanelsTest, ModelCapabilitiesTest, QuickEffortSessionTest, architecture guards and real offline ConfigurationCommandUiTest/ConfigurationPanelUiTest cover this contract. Verification/limits: docs/architecture-panels-20261008.md. This is a local slice on0.6.007/code14, not a new publication.

Local active-work slice: shared pure core/ActiveWork copies workflow/phase/agent facts, static counters, primitive clocks, navigation targets and live/history membership into read-only snapshots. ChatScreen projects once per accepted orchestration snapshot and shares the typed result with ChatHeader/ChatComposer/ChatWorkDock; public ChatScreen JSON API is unchanged. Public ui/OrchestrationEntry retains discovery lifecycle and the existing JSON ActiveOrchestration facade, adapting to internal presentation-only features/orchestration/ActiveWorkScreen. Ticks format primitive time without JSON rereads; copied facts update only with a new snapshot. Saved/finished activity does not become live work, but existing history navigation remains. ActivityMetrics semantics, source order, unknown counters, phase text/glyphs/counts, separate standalone agents, compact/expanded geometry and navigation remain. Checks/limits: docs/architecture-active-work-20261008.md. Local0.6.007/code14, no new publication.

Local transcript-image slice: PiTranscript keys platform-free TranscriptImageSession by URL and loader identity; presentation-only TranscriptImageScreen consumes Compose pixels and an opening callback. Replacement clears old pixels/errors, close rejects late results without recycling shared cached bitmaps, local URLs never load remotely. Public transcript/actions, same-origin MediaLoader and native zoom stay compatible. Checks/limits: docs/architecture-transcript-image-20261008.md. Local0.6.007/code14, no new publication.
